title: Implement Option 1: Peacock Teal ('India Circus' Classic) Vibrant Accent System
description: Implemented vibrant Peacock Teal (#078080) accent system per Option 1 directive, uplifting the brand identity with high-contrast, India Circus-inspired elegance. Configured core design tokens in app/globals.css for :root, .dark, and .light themes, updated header CTA, category pills, trust accents, lookbook tabs, and verified seamless adaptability across Dark and Light modes.
acceptanceCriteria: --color-accent resolves to #078080 (rgb(7, 128, 128)) across dark and light modes
Header Request RFQ button renders with bg-accent (rgb(7, 128, 128)) and high-contrast text
Category pills and active tab indicators use vibrant accent tokens
Generated visual proof screenshots in .agent/screenshots/ and synced to parent brain directory
Zero TypeScript and build errors across all static routes
